preconditions.description: The length of the genome n must be between 4 and 255.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'ACGT?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', and '?'.

postconditions.description: If it is not possible to decode the genome, output '==='.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ACGT' for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == n
postconditions.description: If the genome is decoded, the output must be a string of length n consisting only of 'A', 'C', 'G', and 'T'.
The counts of 'A', 'C', 'G', and 'T' in the output must be equal.
